content.text: No MFN obligation runs against us anywhere in the agreement; § 12.3 expressly disclaims one.

input.quote: Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: The agreement contains no most-favoured-nation or best-terms undertaking running against Customer. Section 12.3 expressly confirms Customer has made no most-favoured-customer commitment, and the pricing provisions (§ 7.1 fixed Fees; § 7.2–7.5; § 8.3 capped renewal uplift) impose no obligation on Customer to extend Vendor terms given to third parties or to match third-party offers. A full-text search for "most-favoured", "favourable/favorable", "no less favourable", "best price", "benchmark", and third-party matching language returned no obligation burdening Customer. The only pricing-related constraints run against Vendor, which is in our favour. No redline required for this rule (other clauses such as §§ 2.1, 2.2 and 12.4 raise separate exclusivity/non-compete issues addressed under different rules).
